spaces.name: Pitch Area
spaces.description: Open pitch stage with a podium, two ceiling projectors mirroring the podium input, a shared presenter laptop, guest Wi-Fi and a keypad-locked door to the equipment room.

assets.name: Left projector
safeTroubleshooting: Check the podium input switch is on HDMI 1
On the laptop press Win+P (Mac: Displays → Mirror) and choose Duplicate
Wait 30 seconds after switching inputs; the projectors re-sync slowly

assets.name: Right projector
safeTroubleshooting: Confirm the left projector shows an image first (both mirror the same input)
Re-seat the HDMI-C cable at the podium, not at the projector
Do not climb or touch the ceiling unit

assets.name: Presenter laptop
safeTroubleshooting: The clicker's USB receiver goes in the left USB-A port
Spare AAA batteries are in the podium drawer

assets.name: Guest Wi-Fi
safeTroubleshooting: The password is on the card next to the door and rotates weekly
Forget the network and re-join if it says 'incorrect password'

assets.name: Equipment room door lock
safeTroubleshooting: Never force the door or share codes in chat
If the keypad doesn't light up, the battery may be low — report it

faqs.q: How do I connect my laptop to the projectors?
faqs.a: Plug the HDMI-C cable at the podium into your laptop, then press Win+P (Mac: Displays → Mirror) and choose Duplicate. Both projectors mirror the podium input.
Use Pitch-Guest-5G. The password is on the card next to the door; it changes every week.

faqs.q: Can I use the presenter laptop?
faqs.a: Yes — log in as Guest (no password). The clicker and spare batteries are in the podium drawer.
Please don't force the door. I can report it to facilities, or you can call the urgent line.

faqs.q: Who do I contact for help?
faqs.a: I can file a ticket in the maintenance portal. For urgent issues, use the urgent phone line shown in the help card.

spaces.name: Conference Room 204
spaces.description: Meeting room with one projector and guest Wi-Fi.

assets.name: Projector
safeTroubleshooting: Check that projector power indicator is on
Confirm HDMI input matches the connected port
Try the laptop's external display option without opening or modifying equipment

assets.name: Guest Wi-Fi
safeTroubleshooting: Confirm you selected the named guest network
Check whether other devices in the room are connected

faqs.q: The projector isn't showing my laptop
faqs.a: Last time this was fixed by switching the input to HDMI 1.

faqs.q: I can't connect to the Wi-Fi
faqs.a: Make sure you joined the named guest network, not a nearby one.

pastReports.summary: Left projector showed 'No signal' with a guest laptop
pastReports.resolution: Laptop display mode was 'Second screen only'; switched to Duplicate (Win+P)

pastReports.summary: Right projector flickers and goes black every few minutes

pastReports.resolution: Replaced the AAA battery; USB receiver moved to the left port

pastReports.summary: Guest Wi-Fi very slow during demo day
pastReports.resolution: Too many devices on 2.4 GHz; moved presenters to Pitch-Guest-5G

pastReports.summary: Equipment room keypad lock not accepting the code
pastReports.note: Facilities informed; keypad shows low-battery blink

pastReports.resolution: Password had rotated; the new one is on the card next to the door
